candidates.requirement: Exercise the default-enabled reparse deferral skip for a partial XML token by making a subsequent nonfinal parse call on the same parser before finalization.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates each parser, then ParseOneInput calls XML_Parse once with isFinal=0 and once with isFinal=1; XML_Parse reaches callProcessor directly or through XML_ParseBuffer.
candidates.failure_condition: The first call starts with m_partialTokenBytesBefore=0, so its doubling condition is satisfied. The second call sets finalBuffer and bypasses the deferral guard. No target parser receives the later nonfinal call needed for the skip.
candidates.alternative_paths: The namespace and external-entity parsers repeat the same two-call pattern. Reset occurs only after those calls and no parser is reused afterward. The separate parse-buffer fuzzer is a different target.
